name: Washington (Maine, United States)
description: A red panel at the hoist with a zigzag edge in navy blue, and a fly of white with two red horizontal stripes and three red stars, after the flag of Washington, D.C.
history: Washington is a town in Knox County, Maine. Its official town flag adapts the flag of Washington, D.C.; English Wikipedia notes that the red panel at the hoist refers to the town's early settlers.

features.role: zigzag edge of the hoist panel
two red stripes on the white fly
